items.title: What energy-sector expertise can bring to Europe’s emerging carbon removal industry
items.summary: Stockholm Exergi publishes an interview with Carlo Sem, Project Director at Saipem, on the construction of Beccs Stockholm. It covers how energy-sector expertise is being applied to turning carbon removal ambitions into a built bio-CCS plant.
items.why_it_matters: Beccs Stockholm is a key Swedish capture node whose construction progress sets the timing of future CO2 shipping volumes from Stockholm to North Sea storage.
